verdict: Spend is running but leads have stalled — only 2 leads from $7,220 this period.
diagnosis: The main call campaign is paused while a retargeting ad still spends, producing a cost per lead near $3,600 — far above healthcare norms.

signals.headline: Only 2 leads from $7,220 spend
signals.detail: Lead volume collapsed this period. Spend continues but the primary call campaign is paused, leaving no active top-of-funnel engine.

signals.headline: 9 purchases worth $5,897 tracked
signals.detail: Return on ad spend sits near 5x on tracked purchases, but the sample is tiny and not a reliable signal yet.

signals.headline: 4,653 clicks but 139 landing views
signals.detail: Click-to-landing drop-off is severe. Either tracking is broken or the landing page is failing to load for most visitors.

signals.headline: 208 direction requests, 1 call click
signals.detail: Google Business Profile drives map interest but almost no phone calls, unusual for a medical alert brand targeting seniors.

signals.headline: Average cost per click near $2.08
signals.detail: Click cost is reasonable for healthcare search. The problem is downstream conversion, not auction pricing.

benchmark.label: Benchmark
benchmark.body: Health and wellness Google Ads average $26 to $67 per lead this year. Specialty medical runs $80 to $200. Liferun's current cost per lead is far above both ranges.

seasonal.label: Seasonal
seasonal.body: Adult children researching gifts and winter fall risk peak in November and December. Pausing the main call campaign now forfeits the strongest quarter for medical alert purchases.

competitor.label: Competitor
competitor.subheader: Category shifting to wearables and fall detection
competitor.body: The home medical alert market reached $4.93B in 2026, growing 11.6% yearly. Competitors push GPS wearables and fall detection as standard features, raising ad creative expectations.

recommendations.title: Reactivate the paused call campaign immediately
recommendations.detail: The search call campaign is paused during peak senior-gifting season. Consider turning it back on with a modest daily cap while you audit performance.

recommendations.title: Audit the click-to-landing-page drop-off
recommendations.detail: Only 139 landing views from 4,653 clicks suggests a tracking break or slow page. Worth testing the pixel and mobile load speed this week.

recommendations.title: Test adult-children messaging for Q4 gifting
recommendations.detail: Research shows adult children are the most motivated buyer segment. Consider a short creative test framing the watch as a holiday gift for aging parents.
